propositions: Recovered RP-02–RP-06 decisions from 2026-08-16 are approved-but-lossy and require evidence-backed derisk research before implementation stories are created.

RP-02 BindingStore transaction semantics and retirement recovery must preserve hard-won bug/test behavior while resolving multi-file atomicity ambiguity between current ADR/implementation and recovered architectural intent.

RP-03 outbound Jira lifecycle protocol requires a bounded retry envelope (3 physical calls, 15s cumulative sleep), scoped failure classification (ticket/endpoint/provider), commit_unknown re-observation, and finite-pass fuse (3 consecutive exhausted across >=2 tickets) to isolate transient provider failures from permanent configuration/auth/capability failures.

RP-04 operation composition must enforce explicit CLI > environment > project > user > default precedence, per-operation snapshot, fail-closed malformed-config behavior, and name the removal of Cloud adapter-local fallback as an approved delta rather than parity.

RP-05 and RP-06 require explicit choices: RP-05 must normalize all 21 visible advanced verb help to side-effect-free package data now (recommended) versus preserving mixed help families; RP-06 must approve effective applicability reversal for activated project criteria and choose parity-first current-run failure projection (recommended) versus normalization of coverage gaps.

All RP-02–RP-06 behavior changes and ambiguities are documented in decision-ready briefs with explicit preservation/delta/correction/choice classification, cross-RP dependencies (RP-03 depends on RP-02/RP-04; RP-04 supplies RP-01/RP-03/RP-05 operation authority; RP-01 owns runtime retry beneath RP-06), and executable validation evidence that must be audited before epic/story creation.
